# Phase Two — Gevurah: Critique Before Expansion

The Awtsmoos is beyond price and possession; finite commerce needs strict boundaries so Awtsmoos.com never confuses desire with authority.

## Architecture Tests
- Do not create a second paid-action system if the existing dirty tree already contains one.
- Do not charge credits for a permanent entitlement unless grant and debit are atomic under one Wallet lock.
- Do not let repeat unlocks consume twice.
- Do not let browser-supplied productId, amount, or purpose become authority.
- Do not render a theme as owned until account testimony says it is owned.
- Do not make premium cosmetics obstruct reading, focus, reduced motion, high contrast, or low-power devices.
- Do not create one huge capability manifest; split product truth from capability definitions and presentation metadata.
- Do not edit long legacy apps merely to add monetization; shared-shell adoption comes first.
- Do not claim catalog/SEO completeness until crawler-visible HTML and canonical metadata are verified.
- Do not hide unfinished product-specific credit sinks; readiness scoring must expose them.

## Improvement Sequence
1. Reconcile current paidActionCatalog/execution/handler modules.
2. Choose one authoritative capability representation and remove conceptual duplication by extension, not deletion.
3. Add universal Radiance entitlement through the existing paid-action execution path if that path already atomically handles fulfillment.
4. Add product-shell presentation only after backend testimony exists.
5. Add tests before broad catalog claims.
6. Generate crawlable inventory next because deployed Apps/Games still expose loading placeholders to crawlers.
7. Continue into recents/search/workflows only after canonical graph generation is stable.
